ppf.travel_menu.prompt.choose_farm: Which farm would you like to travel to?
ppf.chatcmd.clearfarm.help:
{{command}}: clears placed objects and terrain features on a PPF farm.
Usage:
  {{command}}
    Clear the current location if it's a PPF_* farm.
  {{command}} all
    (Host only) Clear all loaded PPF_* farm locations.
Notes:
  - Only the host can run this in multiplayer.
  - Buildings are not removed.
ppf.chatcmd.clearfarm.host_required_all: You need to be the host to use ('{{command}}').
ppf.chatcmd.clearfarm.must_be_inside_ppf: You must be inside a PPF_* farm location to use this (or use '{{command}}').
ppf.chatcmd.clearfarm.owner_id_parse_fai: For some reason, it was not possible to obtain the PPF owner ID.
ppf.chatcmd.clearfarm.cannot_clear_other: You cannot clear other players' farms.
ppf.chatcmd.clearfarm.clear_failed_gener: Failed to clear the farm location.
ppf.chatcmd.clearfarm.cleared_current_re: PPF: farm cleared. If you still see leftovers, exit and re-enter the location.
ppf.chatcmd.uninstall.help:
{{command}}: permanently removes all PPF_* locations created by this mod for this save.
Host only.
Two-step confirmation:
  /{{command}}
    Shows warning and starts a {{seconds}}s confirmation window.
  /{{command}} confirm
    Executes uninstall if still within the window.
Warning:
  Move important items/animals from PPF_* farms to the main Farm before uninstalling.
ppf.chatcmd.uninstall.warning_remove_mod: WARNING: This will remove all PPF_* locations for this save.
ppf.chatcmd.uninstall.preconfirm_move_it: Before continuing, move important items/animals from PPF_* farms to the main Farm.
ppf.chatcmd.uninstall.preconfirm_run_con: If you are sure, run: {{command}} (valid for {{seconds}} seconds).
ppf.chatcmd.uninstall.complete_removed: PPF uninstall complete. Removed {{count}} PPF_* location(s).
ppf.chatcmd.uninstall.post_save_close_re: Now save the game, close it, and remove the mod so PPF_* is not created again.
gmcm.paragraph.text:
Note for multiplayer:
The changes will only take effect after restarting the game.
For consistent behavior, the host and all players must use the same Farm per Player settings.
If players use different values, the entrances/portals may not work or may behave differently for each player.
gmcm.warp_to_ppf_on_house_exit.name: Warp farmhands when leaving the house
gmcm.warp_to_ppf_on_house_exit.tooltip: If enabled, when a farmhand leaves their cabin, they will be redirected to their own PPF_* farm (in front of the farmhouse).
gmcm.redirect_farmhands_to_ppf.name: Redirect farm entrances to PPF (farmhands)
gmcm.redirect_farmhands_to_ppf.tooltip: If enabled, entering the Farm from BusStop, FarmCave, Backwoods, or Forest will send farmhands to their respective farms. The host will still arrive at the main Farm.
gmcm.default_ppf_map_type.name: Default PPF map type (optional)
gmcm.default_ppf_map_type.tooltip:
Optional: forces the default map type used when creating a PPF farm.
Leave empty to use the player's original farm type.
Examples: Maps/Farm, Maps/Farm_Fishing, Maps/Farm_Foraging, Maps/Farm_Mining, Maps/Farm_Combat, Maps/Farm_FourCorners, Maps/Farm_Island, Maps/Farm_Ranching
gmcm.open_travel_menu_key.name: Travel menu key
gmcm.open_travel_menu_key.tooltip: Key used to open the travel menu while in a Farm location (main Farm or any PPF_*). Players can visit each other's farms.
